responsibility: Implements COMPLEX mathematical operations mainly as wrappers around compiler/runtime complex builtins provided through cbuiltin. It maps the ISO ComplexMath API onto cabs/carg/conj/pow/sqrt/log/trigonometric builtins, adds simple Modula-2 helpers for polar construction and scalar multiplication, and provides the module’s exception-status query stub for the complex-math runtime layer.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation module for ComplexMath: unlike ComplexMath.def, it binds the declared operations to cbuiltin complex runtime functions such as cabs, cpow, csqrt, and trig/log helpers, and defines the small helper routines.
